fullDescription:
Wildflowers watercolor set. Floral illustrations flowers and leaves hand painting.

Bright watercolor flowers, clipart for wedding invitation, greeting card, thank you card, party invitation, planner sticker, design blog, website, logo, banner, poster, birthday project, flyer, brochure, cover, presentation, print template, scrapbooking artwork, baby shower and so on.

This set includes 47 items:
– 20 individual elements in PNG files with transparent background (different sizes about 3000 px x 5000 px / 10 in x 16,7 in);
– 2 compositions in PNG files with transparent background (sizes 4500 px x 5000 px / 15 in x 16,7 in);
– 18 frames borders, paper for greeting cards in PNG files with transparent background and JPEG files with white background (7 sizes letter 2400 px x 3300 px / 8 in x 11 in and 2 sizes 7000 px x 5000 px / 23,3 in x 16,7in );
– 6 frames in PNG files with transparent background and JPEG files with white background (sizes about 6000 px x 5000 px / 20 in x 16,7 in).
– 1 repeating border (size 6000 px x 4000 px / 20 in x 13,3 in).
Compatible with all major programs (Photoshop, Word, Canva, GIMP, etc.).
